'''{{PAGENAME}}''' was a [[Quests|Quest]] in ''[[Escape from Tarkov]]''.

==Dialogue==
{{quote|I just can't count how much shit have I seen while working as a gamekeeper. So many different people used to get lost in these woods. Some of them made it out alive and well, some of them didn't. You have to be one hell of a tough asshole to get out of the woods alive. Let's make a real survivalist out of you. Come to me when you're ready.}}

==Objectives==
*Reach the required [[Vitality|Vitality skill]] level of 5

==Rewards==
* +5,900 [[EXP]]
* +2 [[Surgery|Surgery skill]] levels
*[[Jaeger]] Rep <font color="green">'''+0.02'''</font>
* 50,000 Roubles
** 52,500 Roubles with [[Hideout#Modules|Intelligence Center]] Level 1
** 57,500 Roubles with [[Hideout#Modules|Intelligence Center]] Level 2
{{quote|How do people say? What is difficult in training will become easy in a battle! This skill will come in handy, trust me on this one. Your training is almost complete. Looks like you are ready to become the Hunter.}}

==Guide==
You can raise your Vitality level by:
* Taking damage
* Bloodloss

You can use an [[eTG-change regenerative stimulant injector]] or a [[Propital regenerative stimulant injector]] and run through fire or obtain a heavy bleed to level up your vitality
